<?php

/**
 * FIXTURE — not loaded, not scanned, read only by
 * PostWritePinInventoryTest::testADecoyClosureDoesNotPinAWriteBesideIt().
 *
 * EVERY write below is an evaluated ARGUMENT, so each one runs BEFORE
 * pinOnly's body. None is inside a closure body. The guard must report
 * all of them as UNPINNED.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace BCC\Trust\Tests\Fixtures\Decoy;

use BCC\Core\PeepSo\PeepSoAddPostGuard;

final class DecoyClosureFixture
{
    /** A decoy closure in the FIRST argument; the write is the second. */
    public function decoyInFirstArg(): void
    {
        PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly([static fn () => null], wp_insert_post(['post_title' => 'x']));
    }

    /** A decoy in an array element, write still an argument. */
    public function decoyInsideTheIntendedArray(): void
    {
        PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly(['cb' => static function () { return 1; }], wp_update_post(['ID' => 1], true));
    }

    /** A model write as an evaluated argument, decoy alongside. */
    public function decoyWithAModelWrite(): void
    {
        PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly([static fn () => null], new \PeepSoGroup(null, ['name' => 'x']));
    }

    /** A revision write as an evaluated argument. */
    public function decoyWithARevision(): void
    {
        PeepSoAddPostGuard::pinOnly([static fn () => null], wp_save_post_revision(7));
    }
}
